title: I like making tools for myself with AI, like this simple warp mode in Godot
author: Kashmakers

comments.author: Kashmakers
comments.body:
Godot doesn't have a warp mode for their Polygon2D (people have been requesting it [since 2018](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/20601)). And neither does it have a very basic function; letting me select multiple vertexes to move them. No, in Godot, they only only you to select a single one to move. This can be a pain when animating using the Polygon2D node.

So I used AI to write me a plugin that let's me do what I wanted with the Polygon2D, which is to group vertexes, and warp them in a range.

replies.author: Inside-Cantaloupe233
